name: DonorPerfect Gift
description: Provides a Drupal content entity (donorperfect_gift) mapping the DonorPerfect gift/pledge record (dpgift / dpgiftudf tables), read/written through the base module's DPQuery XML API client.
project_description: Submodule of the DonorPerfect integration project. Defines the donorperfect_gift Drupal content entity, whose records live in DonorPerfect (dpgift base table, dpgiftudf user-defined-field table) and are read/written through the base module's DPQuery XML API client. When the DonorPerfect Donor submodule is enabled it adds a donor_id entity reference to the owning donor. Requires the DonorPerfect base module.
